question: A magnet is pulled away from a closed coil. The induced current produces a magnetic field that attracts the magnet. Explain why this does not violate conservation of energy.

options.A: The induced attraction supplies energy to pull the magnet away without any external work.
options.B: An external force must do work against the induced attraction; this work becomes electrical energy in the coil and then heat in its resistance.
options.C: The induced current is produced without any energy transfer because magnetic fields contain unlimited energy.
options.D: The magnet loses its magnetic moment completely, supplying all the electrical energy.
